question: In January 2025, who chaired the high-level review meeting on ISRO’s upcoming missions for 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Jitendra Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. Jitendra Singh, the Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Science and Technology, chaired the high-level review meeting in January 2025.
 
• The meeting focused on the progress and preparations of ISRO's upcoming missions, including advancements in space exploration and satellite launches.
 
• Dr. Jitendra Singh has been instrumental in overseeing India's space program and fostering international collaborations in the space sector.
 
• The review included discussions on ISRO's manned space mission "Gaganyaan" and other significant projects scheduled for 2025.
 
• The meeting highlighted the commitment of the Indian government to strengthen its position as a global leader in space technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**

 
 
• ISRO is the national space agency of India, under the Department of Space, Government of India.
 
• Founded in 1969, ISRO has spearheaded India’s advancements in space technology and applications.
 
• It has successfully launched numerous satellites for communication, earth observation, and navigation.
 
 
 
• **Gaganyaan Mission**
 
 
• Gaganyaan is India’s first human spaceflight mission, aiming to send astronauts to low Earth orbit.
 
• It is a highly ambitious project designed to demonstrate India’s technological capability in manned space exploration.
 
• The mission includes uncrewed test flights before the final manned mission scheduled for 2025.
 
 
 
• **Space Policy and International Collaborations**
 
 
• The Indian government, through ISRO, has strengthened collaborations with international space agencies like NASA, ESA, and JAXA.
 
• These partnerships focus on joint missions, satellite launches, and research in space science.
 
 
 
• **Future Missions**
 
 
• Upcoming missions for 2025 include Chandrayaan-4, Aditya-L1 (solar mission), and a series of satellite launches for defense, agriculture, and communication.
 
• ISRO is also working on reusable launch vehicles and deep space exploration programs.
